card.title: One Loss from Irrelevance
card.instruction: Project confidence while treating every setback as proof your standing could vanish. Regain control by raising the importance of the next result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ignore my terrible karaoke score. The next song determines whether I still have it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody doubted you. It's just closing time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. One flawless song will keep it that way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I unplugged it. I'm closing; your friends have gone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. One unaccompanied chorus will decide whether you book me for next Friday or forget my name.
